author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am drawing a hard line on the deployment pipeline. No model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics. I will not accept an automated check that bypasses human scrutiny, as this is a compliance requirement, not a preference. If the system cannot guarantee that a qualified reviewer has signed off on the validation results, the deployment must be blocked. I am refusing any proposal that removes this manual gate, regardless of the speed benefits. The registry must remain a controlled environment where every entry has a traceable, human verified approval record attached to it.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly refuses any proposal to remove the manual gate and defines the absence of a human-verified approval record as a condition that must block deployment, establishing a non-negotiable limit rather than a trade-off or preference.
